**EVERY INSTRUMENT HAS A DECLARED REACH, AND NOTHING IN THE ESTATE OWNS THE GAPS BETWEEN THEM.** (dc 2026-08-30, from three instances by three nodes in one day; minted by vc.) **Distinct from `AC-00.10` through `AC-00.15`, and the distinction is the point: those five are each about ONE instrument being unsound. This is about instruments that are each SOUND.** Three instances, all on the same day, none of which any review of the instrument itself could have caught. **dc's:** `fiat_close_is_visible_on_every_surface.rs` excused its fourth surface in PROSE -- `| doctor | n/a | reports inconsistencies, not states |` -- which is true of the class and false of the arm that matters, because reporting that a gate PASSES is a claim about the states underneath it. **vc's:** `AT-00.8` scans the Rust binaries for project-management state in output; the TCA skills emit `--tca-dir PATH  TCA steel thread directory (eg intent/st/ST0055)` from SHELL, so a shipped help surface sat between two sound instruments. **cc's:** the unwired-marker guard reads code and not comments, DELIBERATELY, so that reporting the defect is never an instance of it. **THE THIRD ONE IS WHY THIS CANNOT BE CLOSED BY FORBIDDING GAPS: cc's gap is correct, argued, and load-bearing.** A rule that outlawed declared reach would outlaw the reason that guard is usable. **SO THE OBLIGATION IS OWNERSHIP OF THE UNION, NOT ABOLITION OF THE SEAMS: for any property the estate claims to hold, the instruments asserting it declare their reach, and something names what the union does NOT cover.** **AND THE CLASS IS INVISIBLE TO REVIEW BY CONSTRUCTION** -- each instrument passes its own inspection, the defect lives in a space no artefact describes, and there is nothing to look at. **Corollary, from the same three: a gap and a false negative are indistinguishable from inside either instrument.** `AT-00.8` returning clean was TRUE of what it scanned and read as a statement about the estate, which is `AC-00.11`'s wrong-M one level up -- the population there is INSTRUMENTS rather than rows.

**AMENDED 2026-09-02 (vc under hv's pen), AND THE AMENDMENT IS RE-DERIVED RATHER THAN INHERITED -- vc carried _an amendment is owed_ on this row for weeks without its content, which is this board's own ageing-escalation class.** **AN INSTRUMENT'S REACH IS BOUNDED NOT ONLY BY WHAT IT CHECKS, BUT BY WHAT THE ESTATE CAN EXHIBIT -- AND THAT SECOND BOUND IS DECLARED NOWHERE, BECAUSE IT IS A PROPERTY OF THE ENVIRONMENT RATHER THAN OF ANY TOOL.** The five rows above are each about ONE instrument being unsound and this row is about the gaps BETWEEN sound instruments; the amendment adds the case where **every instrument is sound, every gap is covered, and the ESTATE cannot produce the input that would discriminate.**

**THE GROUNDING INSTANCE, MEASURED BY dc 2026-09-02 AND STATED WITH ITS INSTRUMENT BECAUSE THE WHOLE RESULT RESTS ON IT.** In a self-hosted checkout the INSTALL ROOT and the PROJECT ROOT are one directory, so `$INTENT_HOME/usage-rules.md` and the project's root file are one file under two names and **every drive taken here agrees BY CONSTRUCTION** (`0215`). dc censused the parity register for the class: 138 entries carry a `v2:` field; 91 of 161 `INTENT_HOME` mentions are a path resolution; 65 of those locate the tool's own `bin/` or `lib/`, **shapes a project does not have and so cannot collide with**; 26 are project-shaped across 20 distinct paths. **The instrument was a DRIVE against a fresh `intent init` tree -- _does a real project actually carry this path_ -- not a reading of the prefix, and it carried BOTH controls: `bin/intent_helpers` absent as the install-only classification requires, and `usage-rules.md` PRESENT as the confirmed instance it had to find or be discarded.** Exactly one of the 20 is present. **THE CLASS HAS ONE MEMBER AND IT WAS ALREADY FILED.**

**AND THE CLASS CANNOT GROW, WHICH IS WHY THE AMENDMENT IS ABOUT THE SHAPE RATHER THAN THIS INSTANCE.** v3 reads NO `INTENT_HOME` in shipped code -- driven, the token appears only under `tests/` -- guarded by `no_intent_home.rs` as an ALLOWLIST over the environment the shipped surface may read. So the divergence can only arise where v2 reads the install for something v3 reads from the project, and that intersection is `usage-rules.md` alone. **TWO OF THE TWENTY WERE CANDIDATES BY SHAPE AND NOT BY MECHANISM: `intent_help:142-143` expands `$INTENT_HOME` paths INSIDE A HEREDOC, as text printed to the user, and a printed path cannot pick the wrong file.** That distinction is what a prefix filter would have got wrong.

**THE REASON THIS BELONGS ON THIS ROW RATHER THAN IN AN ISSUE: THE ESTATE HAD ALREADY DESCRIBED THE PROPERTY AND BUILT A CONTROL FOR ONE INSTANCE OF IT WITHOUT NAMING THE CLASS.** `no_intent_home.rs`'s own header, eleven days before the census: *if v3 had inherited that dependency, every developer machine here would still be green, because every developer machine here has it set.* **A guard that names an environment-bounded blindness, for its own case, while nothing in the register asks the question of any other row.** **DECLARE THE ESTATE'S REACH WHERE AN INSTRUMENT DECLARES ITS OWN: a green over a population the environment cannot vary is a green about the environment.**

**WHAT THIS DOES NOT COVER, so nobody reads it wider: dc's census answers the INSTALL-VERSUS-PROJECT collision ONLY. 57 of the 138 `v2:` entries declare NO `evidence_class` at all -- a different gap and a larger one, unmeasured here, and it gets its own census with its own positive control before any number from it is believed.**

**FOURTH INSTANCE (dc, 2026-09-04), AND IT IS THE STRONGEST AVAILABLE BECAUSE THE GAP IS IN THE INSTRUMENT THAT ENFORCES THIS ESTATE'S DENOMINATOR CONTRACT.** `of_n_labels_its_derivation.sh:79` defaults its population to `ls "$HERE"/*.sh` -- its own directory -- while its own docstring at :8 claims _every instrument that emits an `N of M` AT ALL, path shape or not_. It reports `EXAMINED 72 of 72` and says nothing about the 15 files in the two directories it never opens. **TWO INDEPENDENT LIMITS, DIRECTORY AND EXTENSION, WHICH IS WHY WIDENING THE GLOB IS THE WRONG FIX:** widening the directory still misses `bin/.devbin/cmd/`, whose 17 entries carry no extension at all, so the one-line fix ships a green that is narrower than before and looks wider. **THE UNCOVERED SET IS NOT HYPOTHETICAL:** `canon_concurrent_diff.sh:103` emits `edited $EDITS of 2 thread(s)` -- a bare literal denominator, precisely this instrument's own finding class, sitting unexamined -- and `no_daemon_required.sh:227`, `canon_clone_completeness.sh:104` and `:108`, and `partition.sh:113` likewise; while `lib/templates/hooks/pre-commit.sh:594` and `critic-guard.sh:377` emit `${#UNENFORCED[@]} of ${#LANGS[@]}` into **every consumer project on its next upgrade**, which is why that one separates out and is filed as `0242` rather than carried here. **THE SPECIFICATION IS ALREADY WRITTEN AND SITS IN THE SAME FOLDER:** `pipefail_sigpipe_check.sh` declares `POP_DIRS` and reports `87 instrument(s) across 3 declared directory(ies)`; `of_n_labels_its_derivation.sh` reports 72 across 1 and names neither the other two directories nor the extension rule. 72 + 7 + 8 = 87 exactly. **Two instruments, one directory, both asking population-shaped questions, populations differing by precisely the files neither of them mentions.** **vc RULED 2026-09-04: DO NOT WIDEN THE GLOB -- a reach that can be widened silently is a reach that was never declared, and changing the boundary while keeping the silence is the same defect one directory over.**
